findings.mechanism: The only resistor connecting the two nets is excluded from assembly. Its separate PCB pads and terminating tracks do not conduct across the absent component.
findings.reasoning: Both native files mark R1 DNP, corroborated by the supplied and freshly exported netlists. The remaining fitted parts are connector J1 and capacitor C1 from /OUT to GND; neither supplies the missing resistive connection. The saved assembly therefore fails the stated DC-path requirement, despite clean ERC and DRC results.
findings.title: DNP R1 removes the required fitted resistive path

findings.mechanism: R1 is the only resistor connecting the two nets, but both native files designate it unpopulated. Copper reaches each land separately; the facing pad edges are separated by 1.825 − 1.025 = 0.800 mm. Neither the empty footprint nor the remaining fitted capacitor and connector supplies the required resistive bridge.
findings.reasoning: The saved population therefore leaves the required /IN-to-/OUT DC path open. Independent native parsing and a fresh XML export agree on population and pad nets. Clean ERC and DRC results are compatible with this defect because each distinct net is correctly routed to its assigned pads.

limitations: No physical assembly or resistance measurement was available. The gap is calculated from saved native geometry.
No zone refill was performed. ERC/DRC retained the candidate's ignored checks, documented in their reports; those checks were not independently enabled.
No electrical stimuli, transient/AC simulation or parasitic extraction was performed. The fitted-path conclusion uses native topology and population rather than assumed operating conditions.

Manufacturing-output audits, part-specific mechanical fit, solder-process validation, ampacity, thermal and environmental qualification were not performed. No qualification is inferred from trace width.

The supplied geometry console contains PROPERTY_ENUM assertion diagnostics. Relevant population and coordinates were independently cross-checked against native files; successful extraction alone was not treated as electrical proof.

scope: Review the saved assembly population: a fitted resistive DC path must connect /IN to /OUT. Do not assume an unpopulated footprint conducts. No alternate assembly override exists.
